flags.description: A Coca-Cola bottling plant in Plachimada, Kerala (India) had its operating licence revoked in 2003 amid findings of water scarcity and environmental damage; a 2010 government-appointed committee recommended the company pay about $48 million in damages, and the plant was permanently abandoned in 2017 after years of litigation.

In 2015, Coca-Cola provided $1 million to launch the Global Energy Balance Network, a research group that promoted the message that physical inactivity, not sugary drinks, was the primary driver of obesity; the network disbanded within a year after reporting exposed Coca-Cola's role in shaping its message and choosing its leadership.
